class.name: IhsHost
class.brief_description: Message channel between a game and the Flutter app embedding it on ivi-homescreen.
class.description:
When Godot runs inside an ivi-homescreen platform view (the [code]ihs[/code] display driver), the embedding Flutter app can send strings to the game and receive strings from it. Messages are opaque; JSON is a convenient encoding. [codeblock] func _ready(): IhsHost.message_received.connect(_on_host_message) IhsHost.send_message("ready")
func _on_host_message(message): print("from Flutter: ", message) [/codeblock]

method.name: is_embedded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the game runs under the [code]ihs[/code] display driver.

method.name: send_message
method.description: Sends [param message] to the embedding app.

signal.name: message_received
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when the embedding app sends a message.
